order_return_items_remainder_condition_v.name: order_return_items_remainder_condition_valid
order_return_items_remainder_condition_v.value: "order_return_items"."remainder_condition" is null or ("order_return_items"."condition" = 'Resalable' and "order_return_items"."accepted_quantity" < "order_return_items"."quantity" and "order_return_items"."remainder_condition" in ('Damaged', 'Defective', 'Used', 'Lost', 'Non-returnable'))

payroll_entries_payment_fields_valid.name: payroll_entries_payment_fields_valid
payroll_entries_payment_fields_valid.value: ("payroll_entries"."payment_status" = 'Pending' and "payroll_entries"."payment_date" is null and "payroll_entries"."payment_method" is null and "payroll_entries"."paid_by" is null and "payroll_entries"."paid_at" is null and "payroll_entries"."received_at" is null and "payroll_entries"."confirmed_by" is null) or ("payroll_entries"."payment_status" = 'Paid' and "payroll_entries"."payment_date" is not null and "payroll_entries"."payment_method" is not null and "payroll_entries"."paid_by" is not null and "payroll_entries"."paid_at" is not null and "payroll_entries"."received_at" is null and "payroll_entries"."confirmed_by" is null) or ("payroll_entries"."payment_status" = 'Received' and "payroll_entries"."payment_date" is not null and "payroll_entries"."payment_method" is not null and "payroll_entries"."paid_by" is not null and "payroll_entries"."paid_at" is not null and "payroll_entries"."received_at" is not null and "payroll_entries"."confirmed_by" is not null)

payroll_entry_adjustments_type_valid.name: payroll_entry_adjustments_type_valid
payroll_entry_adjustments_type_valid.value: ("payroll_entry_adjustments"."kind" = 'earning' and "payroll_entry_adjustments"."type" in ('Overtime', 'Bonus', 'Allowance', 'Reimbursement', 'Other compensation')) or ("payroll_entry_adjustments"."kind" = 'deduction' and "payroll_entry_adjustments"."type" in ('Deduction', 'Cash advance recovery'))

vehicle_assignments_odometer_valid.name: vehicle_assignments_odometer_valid
vehicle_assignments_odometer_valid.value: ("vehicle_assignments"."start_odometer" is null or "vehicle_assignments"."start_odometer" >= 0) and ("vehicle_assignments"."end_odometer" is null or "vehicle_assignments"."end_odometer" >= coalesce("vehicle_assignments"."start_odometer", 0))

vehicle_maintenance_dates_valid.name: vehicle_maintenance_dates_valid
vehicle_maintenance_dates_valid.value: ("vehicle_maintenance"."started_on" is null or ("vehicle_maintenance"."started_on" ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' and "vehicle_maintenance"."started_on"::date::text="vehicle_maintenance"."started_on")) and ("vehicle_maintenance"."completed_on" is null or ("vehicle_maintenance"."completed_on" ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' and "vehicle_maintenance"."completed_on"::date::text="vehicle_maintenance"."completed_on")) and ("vehicle_maintenance"."completed_on" is null or "vehicle_maintenance"."started_on" is null or "vehicle_maintenance"."completed_on" >= "vehicle_maintenance"."started_on")

vehicles_capacity_valid.name: vehicles_capacity_valid
vehicles_capacity_valid.value: ("vehicles"."capacity_value" is null and "vehicles"."capacity_unit" is null) or ("vehicles"."capacity_value" is not null and "vehicles"."capacity_unit" is not null and "vehicles"."capacity_value" > 0 and length(trim("vehicles"."capacity_unit")) > 0)

vehicles_dates_valid.name: vehicles_dates_valid
vehicles_dates_valid.value: ("vehicles"."registration_expires_on" is null or ("vehicles"."registration_expires_on" ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' and "vehicles"."registration_expires_on"::date::text="vehicles"."registration_expires_on")) and ("vehicles"."insurance_expires_on" is null or ("vehicles"."insurance_expires_on" ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' and "vehicles"."insurance_expires_on"::date::text="vehicles"."insurance_expires_on"))
